name: Russell E. Heacock
trade: counsellor and attorney at law, land conveyancing, justice of the peace business, and a land agency office

proprietors.name: Russell E. Heacock
proprietors.basis: The register matches the printed name to the town card heacock_russel_e (action: enrich), so this is the same person the resident layer already holds. Dated by the printing window, which bounds the reading and does not date the partnership.

locations.basis: Placeable against the committed town. A crossing of two platted streets: franklin and lake.
locations.limit_reason: The register places this house against franklin+lake and the town holds no roof of its own for it (action: new_building), so the anchor is as far as the reading goes.

dates.basis: No opening is announced. The first printing, 1835-05-27, is the bound: the house was trading by then and the record does not say when it began.

proprietor_community.basis: The 1 keeper(s) this record names and the resident layer holds a card for all read southern: Russell E. Heacock (southern). A house is not its keeper, so the reading is an inference about the house and is capped there.

replaceable_by: A directory, a deed or a later reading that names this house's premises, its staff or its dates more exactly than the newspapers do.
